news.title: Full year 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹2.45 (vs ₹1.52 in FY 2025)
news.body: Full year 2026 results: EPS: ₹2.45 (up from ₹1.52 in FY 2025). Revenue: ₹319.4m (up 32% from FY 2025). Net income: ₹28.4m (up 7.9% from FY 2025). Profit margin: 8.9% (down from 11% in FY 2025). The decrease in margin was driven by higher expenses. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 14% per year but the company’s share price has increased by 29% per year, which means it is tracking significantly ahead of earnings growth.

It also increases the risk of potential losses in the short term as the stock tends to have larger drops in price more frequently than other stocks.
